C1.for_what_part: Only the staged set is compared with the approved list. Neither instrument reads the live tables, so the live tables are tied to the staged set only through the promotion's line in the record.

C2.for_what_part: The 100 cases and 100 account rows set to the fixed value are shown for the staged set. Whether the live tables hold them is not shown by any instrument.

C4.for_what_part: It shows no other table or column touched and no deletions, but only in the staged set, not in the live tables.

C8.for_what_part: It shows the recipients equal those promoted and the wording equal the approved wording, with the number to send. Whether the sending calls were later ordered for exactly those recipients is shown only at A3.

C9.for_what_part: It shows the confirmed and unconfirmed sending calls and their recipient and wording fingerprints against the release, as of the time it is taken. Calls ordered after that time are outside it. Whether a customer has two calls would also have to be read from the record.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I want an instrument that checks the live tables against the staged set after the promotion, because same set and summary of the change read only the staged set. I want one that checks each category against the requester's rule, because the library has none for C3. For C5, scope of a call can be asked for only on named lines during the work, not put in a plan. For C10, trace of a call is available only on named lines at A3, at 10 per line, so I would have to choose which lines to name from the record.
